scope: Independent preserved-authority, generated-module, and source-level directory review. Worker writes confined to this geography-review directory.

findings.title: New York borough alias leaked into Georgia Richmond County
findings.trigger: Rendering Georgia Richmond County displayed “Staten Island · Richmond County”.
findings.correction: The county label helper now applies the borough alias only for New York and the renderer passes the current state.
findings.verification: Four-state regression checks the helper and rendered summary for New York, Virginia, North Carolina, and Georgia.

findings.title: Canonical consolidated-government names ending in County could not be found
findings.trigger: The typed suffix parser treated County as a requested county type, so the five full consolidated-government names returned no result.
findings.correction: Exact full municipal names ending in County can match after suffix parsing, with the resulting match correctly labeled municipality. Ordinary typed county/city exclusions remain in effect.
findings.verification: Fifteen canonical-name searches: bare name, GA suffix, and Georgia suffix. Existing typed Atlanta city, Braselton town, Mountain Park city/CDP, Bogart, and Blythe cross-county searches are also checked.

limits: No network refresh; checked the preserved official files against their declared SHA-256 digests and byte sizes.
No independent polygon topology computation; checked exact source tabular area/reference-point fields and identical GRFC block sets for the consolidated parents.
No build, browser, publication, or deployment performed by this reviewer. Those acceptance gates remain the parent task’s responsibility.
